arrival.prompt: The river is made of forms. The forms are moving. Choose a crossing.
arrival.depthLine: DEPTH: {depth} BUSINESS DAYS. Measurement taken by someone who is out this week.

conditions: CONDITIONS: The approver is at an offsite. The offsite is about approval velocity.
CONDITIONS: A change freeze is in effect. The freeze has an exception process. The process is frozen.
CONDITIONS: The board meets Thursdays. Today is Thursday. The meeting has been moved to respect focus time.
CONDITIONS: Emergency changes are being expedited. The expedition queue is nine deep and sorted alphabetically.
CONDITIONS: The release window closes Friday. It is not recorded which Friday.
CONDITIONS: Water levels are within tolerance. Tolerance was redefined this morning.

options.label: FORD THE RIVER
options.hint: Ship it now. Tell them Monday. Fast; the river decides how fast.

options.label: CAULK THE WAGON AND FLOAT
options.hint: Build a feature flag, ship dark, flip it from the far bank. Costs {tokens} tokens.

options.label: TAKE THE FERRY — FILE THE PERMIT
options.hint: Zero risk. The ferry departs when the Permit clears. Estimates available on filing.

options.label: WAIT FOR CONDITIONS TO IMPROVE
options.hint: Free. The conditions are posted daily.

ford_success: You ford at night. The water is exactly as deep as the paperwork said, which surprises everyone involved with the paperwork.
You are across by morning. On Monday you mention it. The board notes an unexplained increase in throughput and forms a working group to contain it.
ford_failure: Midstream, the wagon finds the depth the measurement missed. The measurement stands; the wagon does not.
Two green builds wash downstream, past the plaque about preventing incidents. A retrospective is scheduled. It is described as blameless in the invitation and nowhere else.
ford_register: {member} has been placed on the Enhanced Delivery Oversight register. The register is described as supportive. It has a dashboard, a cadence, and no exit criteria.
caulk_success: You build the flag, seal the seams, and float across in the dark. The change ships disabled, which the river cannot distinguish from the change not shipping.
From the far bank you flip it on. Nothing announces this. Nothing needed to. That was the entire mechanism.
caulk_scrape: One seam leaks: the flag defaults ON in a single environment. It is the environment with the auditors in it.
You bail from dry land and patch the default. The change ends the day dark everywhere it should be. A day is spent. A finding is opened, then closed, then framed.
ferry_file: You file the Permit. It is fourteen pages. Page nine asks for the outcome of the change, in the past tense.
The dock has a bench. The bench has a plaque. ESTIMATED WAIT: {wait} BUSINESS DAYS.
ferry_cve: Day {day} at the dock: a dependency of a dependency publishes a CVE. You have never called it. It has never been called. It ships anyway, and so does its advisory.
Your Permit is reclassified from STANDARD to ELEVATED. Reclassification restarts the clock. The clock does not call this a restart. It calls it a clarification.
NEW ESTIMATED WAIT: {wait} BUSINESS DAYS. The bench is still available.
ferry_arrive: The ferry crosses in eleven minutes. It is a good ferry. The crossing was never the hard part.
{days} days at the dock. Zero incidents. The plaque about incidents will not mention the days, and the plaque about the days does not exist.
wait: You wait. Conditions do not improve. Conditions are not aware of you.
On day {days}, a second party arrives, reads the same conditions, and fords the river in an afternoon. They wave from the far bank. Your party waves back. Morale does not.

ui.registerNote: ! {member} IS ON THE ENHANCED DELIVERY OVERSIGHT REGISTER
ui.cannotAffordCaulk: Requires {tokens} tokens. The flag must be built before it can be flipped.
